plain: A hostile act in return for an injury or attack

webster.text: The seizure or taking of any thing from an enemy by way of retaliation or indemnification for something taken or detained by him.

more.text: That which is taken from an enemy to indemnify an owner for something of his which the enemy has seized.

example.quote: There would of course be always danger that the rights of other nations might be infringed by their decisions, so as to afford occasions of reprisal and war.
